name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 9 visits over 52 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 47 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2025-11-28, at wavelengths from 1.13 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
